Warm Spring (D).title: Warm Spring (D) - Fresh, Warm, Clear
Warm Spring (D).description: You read warm and bright overall. Clear warm colors add healthy energy and keep skin looking lively.
Warm Spring (D).style_note: Keep contrast medium-high with warm accents.

Neutral Spring (D).title: Neutral Spring (D) - Warm-leaning, Balanced Brightness
Neutral Spring (D).description: You are spring-like but can be overwhelmed by very hot, very saturated tones. Balanced warm-bright shades work best.
Neutral Spring (D).style_note: Use one bright accent with softer warm supports.

Warm Autumn (A).title: Warm Autumn (A) - Rich, Earthy, Golden
Warm Autumn (A).description: You support warmth and depth. Earth-based tones create cohesion and natural polish.
Warm Autumn (A).style_note: Layer textured warm neutrals for depth.

Soft Autumn (A).title: Soft Autumn (A) - Muted Warmth
Soft Autumn (A).description: You are warm but better in softened, blended tones than in intense saturation.
Soft Autumn (A).style_note: Favor tonal combinations over sharp contrast.

Cool Summer (B).title: Cool Summer (B) - Cool, Soft, Elegant
Cool Summer (B).description: Cool undertones with balanced softness. Refined, blended cool shades look naturally flattering.
Cool Summer (B).style_note: Keep transitions smooth and moderately low contrast.

Soft Summer (B).title: Soft Summer (B) - Muted Cool
Soft Summer (B).description: You suit cool hues with extra softness and lower contrast.
Soft Summer (B).style_note: Prioritize muted cool palettes with low-medium contrast.

Cool Winter (C).title: Cool Winter (C) - Clear, Cool, High Definition
Cool Winter (C).description: You handle cool clarity and strong contrast well. Crisp cool tones create impact.
Cool Winter (C).style_note: Use clean contrast and saturated cool accents.

Bright Winter (C).title: Bright Winter (C) - High Contrast, Vivid Cool
Bright Winter (C).description: You support especially strong contrast and high chroma cool colors.
Bright Winter (C).style_note: Lean into vivid cool color with crisp value contrast.
